Supplementary Fig. S3 CD36+ macrophages selectively interact with active metabolic
ZCCHC12+ tumor cells in PTC. A, Violin plots displaying marker genes expression in
epithelial cell subtypes. B, Heatmap displaying the inferred CNV profiles of single cells
(y axis). C, Violin plots illustrating ZCCHC12 expression in tumor cells from patients
of European and East Asian ancestries. D, Boxplots displaying ZCCHC12 expression
in adenocarcinoma. E, Violin plots showing metabolism-related gene expression in
epithelial cell subtypes. F, Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) of ZCCHC12+ tumor
cells from scRNA-seq dataset. ES, enrichment score; NES, normalized enrichment
score.
